mapper.update: UPDATE member_record SET display_name=#{input.value}status=#{input.value},version=version+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND member_id=#{id} AND version=#{input.expectedVersion} AND status<>'CLOSED'
mapper.select: SELECT version,action,before_value,after_value,reason,actor_id,created_at FROM member_change WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND member_id=#{id} AND version>#{after} ORDER BY version LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT member_id,actor_id,display_name,member_level,status,version FROM member_record WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND member_id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT member_id,actor_id,display_name,member_level,status,version FROM member_record WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND member_id=#{id}
SELECT member_id,actor_id,display_name,member_level,status,version FROM member_record WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND member_id > #{after} ORDER BY member_id LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT member_id,actor_id,display_name,member_level,status,version FROM member_record WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND actor_id=#{actor}
